assets.prompt: Create new jetpack animation variants of the supplied exact doodle soldier reference for a 2D side scrolling comic game. Reference identity must stay: big white rounded face, two simple black eyes, plain round helmet with curved brim, thick clean black outer contours, thinner inner details, opaque near-white clothing, short simple limbs. Replace the ordinary backpack with a compact TWIN NOZZLE ROCKET JETPACK with short warm orange exhaust. Transparent RGBA background, no ground, no shadows, no labels or grid. Production sprite sheet exactly 3 rows x 4 columns, 12 separate complete silhouettes with generous transparent gutters, facing right, consistent same head/body scale in every cell. Row1 four rifle jetpack hero frames: upright hover feet dangling; hover legs alternate; forward flying body tilted slightly legs trailing; recoil/hit pose but still holding rifle. Row2 four hero frames: rocket launcher hover; rocket launcher forward flying; combat knife hover; knife slash with arm extended. Row3: enemy jetpack rifle soldier hover and forward flying (same comic simplicity but black goggles and striped helmet); tiny pursuit drone forward flight frame A and frame B with propellers visibly rotated. Each image centered in its cell, enough padding for gun barrels, complete jetpack and both feet, never crop or overlap. No baked motion streaks, no complex shading, no dense hatching; strong readable black/white silhouettes. This is one game sprite sheet asset, not a concept poster.

Create one production 2D mini boss animation sprite sheet for a black-and-white doodle side-scrolling game, matching the supplied simple round soldier reference's clean thick ink contours, opaque ivory/white fill and sparse interior details. A compact whimsical armed interception helicopter, side view facing RIGHT, rounded pilot canopy containing one helmeted doodle pilot, small under-nose cannon pointing horizontally right, two readable side missile pods, short tail with tail rotor and landing skids. Four complete helicopter frames exactly 2x2 cells on genuine transparent background. Upper left: hovering intact with long main rotor horizontal. Upper right: same exact helicopter/proportions with main rotor at diagonal rotation, tail rotor alternate rotation. Lower left: firing pose, nose cannon slight recoil and missile pod open, no projectile/no bright explosion baked in. Lower right: damaged helicopter with a few cracks and bent panel but same full silhouette; intact remaining rotor. Each rotor, tail, skids and nose completely contained in generous cell margins; same body scale and pivot all four frames. NOT photorealistic, no gradient metal, no heavy textures, no labels, no grid, no shadows or background. This is a friendly comic mechanical opponent in the same world as reference, not a tank and not a giant airliner.
